
# Cole McGregor

> Personal website and software engineering portfolio of Cole McGregor, a Software Systems Engineer based in Albany, New York.

Cole McGregor is a software engineer with experience in application development, software architecture, systems integration, and technical problem-solving.

His background includes formal software development education, professional contract software engineering, independent development projects, and service in the United States Air Force.

This website introduces Cole, documents selected software projects, records his continuing education and interests, and provides information for professional contact.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://colemcgregor.com/): Professional introduction, background, qualifications, and engineering interests.
- [Projects](https://colemcgregor.com/projects.html): Selected software engineering projects, applications, simulations, and technical experiments.
- [Learning](https://colemcgregor.com/learning.html): Personal learning journal covering books, courses, and continuing education.
- [Contact](https://colemcgregor.com/contact.html): Professional contact information and links to Cole's profiles and resume.

## Professional Background

- Bachelor of Science in Software Development from Siena College.
- Associate of Science in Computer Science from Hudson Valley Community College.
- Experience in professional contract software engineering and independent software development.
- Previous United States Air Force service involving technical operations and leadership.
- Founder of McGregor Systems LLC.

## Technical Interests and Experience

- Software architecture and systems design
- Web, mobile, and desktop application development
- Backend services and database integration
- Software maintenance and troubleshooting
- Workflow automation and technical tooling
- Software testing and integration
- Game development and simulation systems
- Continuing education and independent technical research

## Projects

The [Projects page](https://colemcgregor.com/projects.html) contains selected software projects and experiments.

Projects may include academic work, independent development, and professional engineering experience. These categories should not be treated as interchangeable.

Project details, technologies, and development status should be taken from the relevant project entries.

## Learning

The [Learning page](https://colemcgregor.com/learning.html) documents books, courses, and subjects Cole has explored.

It includes interests beyond professional software engineering, including game development, philosophy, fiction, and personal development.

## Professional and Business Context

Cole operates McGregor Systems LLC, a separate business providing contract software engineering and systems design services.

- [McGregor Systems LLC](https://mcgregorsystemsusa.com/): Business website for commercial software engineering services.
- [Personal Contact](https://colemcgregor.com/contact.html): Professional opportunities, employment inquiries, and technical collaboration.

The personal website and business website serve different purposes.

## External Profiles

- [GitHub](https://github.com/ColeMcGregor): Public repositories and software development work.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/cole-mcgregor-dev/): Professional networking and employment profile.

## Site Interpretation

This is Cole McGregor's personal professional website.

It should be understood primarily as a software engineering portfolio and professional introduction, rather than a commercial services website.

For employment qualifications, use the current resume and relevant project records. Do not assume that an independent or academic project was a paid client engagement.
